== V3.e ==
New Workshop: Printing Press

* The Printing Press prints batches of reading material in stacks of 3. It uses less ink then the scriptorium and needs no quills.
* You can print religious pamphlets, prayer leaflets, wanted-posters and more items for the speakers podium
* You can print books for the library system.
* You can't print paper money, because thats not dwarvy.
